backlogDepth.description: Count of work units still pending release.

wip.description: Count of work units currently released and in progress.

mode.description: ReleaseFed pools are volume-controlled by this service (WIP limit is a hard invariant); FlowFed pools admit on priority only (WIP limit is an alarm threshold, not enforced).
mode.title: PoolMode

overAlarmThreshold.description: Whether backlogDepth has crossed this pool's alarm threshold.

remainingCapacityKnown.description: Present only when the request supplied a `cutoffAt` query parameter (ADR-0018). `false` for a FlowFed path (no hard admission ceiling) or a ReleaseFed path with no WIP limit provisioned.

remainingCapacityUnits.description: Present only when `remainingCapacityKnown` is `true` — the path's WIP limit minus its current WIP (always non-negative, since the aggregate never admits past its own WIP limit).

400.description: Malformed request body (invalid JSON), a missing required field (silently-defaulted zero values are never accepted), an invalid field value (e.g. negative quantity, empty path id), a `pathId` outside the deployment's declared process-path families (`unknown-path-id`), or a malformed query parameter (e.g. empty or non-RFC3339 `cutoffAt`).

schema.description: RFC 7807 (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7807) Problem Details for HTTP APIs. Every error response in this service uses this shape with Content-Type application/problem+json.

type.description: A URI identifying the error category (does not need to resolve to a real page). Stable per distinct error category in this service.

status.description: Duplicates the HTTP status code (RFC 7807 requirement).

detail.description: The specific error message for this occurrence.

instance.description: The request path that produced the error, omitted if there is no natural resource path.
